meaningEvidence: Exact owner-published media binding, full61.971202-second MP4/audio, full Albanian ASR used as dialect aid, 13-frame timeline and original-resolution sword views reviewed.

Creator narrates armoured riders, the imagined physical difficulty of carrying equipment, then a long curved sword he calls Skanderbeg’s; source caption explicitly frames a memory from a Vienna museum.
Visible green case contains several helmets, armour pieces, a shield and a long curved blade; no goat-head crest visible. Small labels cannot be read reliably.
limitations: Original filming date unestablished; source posting date verified.
Not a measured horse-speed, armour-weight or combat test. No garbled ASR quotation or numeric speed retained.
Filmed sword resembles the relevant war-knife type but no reliable filmed label/inventory number confirms A145 identification.
A145 catalogue former attribution preserved; no claim that Skanderbeg used an object dated after his death. No claim that the shown armour was his.
